captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a hydraulic dropper seatpost for a bicycle. It consists of a dark grey/black outer tube with a collar, an inner telescoping golden post, and a grey saddle rail clamp assembly at the top. A side-mounted cable guide runs along the outer tube, secured by two small brackets, providing realistic external routing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a hydraulic dropper seatpost. Create a black outer tube with a collar, a telescoping golden inner post, and a grey saddle rail clamp assembly at the top. Add an external cable routing system with a thin black guide tube secured by small brackets along the side of the outer tube.
captions.factory: Construct the outer post using cylinders for the main tube and collar, then add small boxes and cylinders along the side to model the cable routing guides and brackets. Create the inner post as a separate telescoping cylinder. Construct the saddle clamp assembly at the top using combined box and cylinder primitives to form the clamp base, rail channels, and mounting bolts. Define a prismatic joint between the outer and inner posts to allow telescoping articulation.
